INC0049217.title: prod-db-7 — firewall rule allows public ingress on 5432
INC0049217.body:
Config-audit monitor flagged that security-group rule sg-acctbilling-data was modified by a Terraform apply at 2026-06-26T07:42:09Z and now allows inbound TCP/5432 (PostgreSQL) from 0.0.0.0/0. prod-db-7 hosts the `customers` and `billing_info` tables for the acct-billing data plane.

The database listener on prod-db-7:5432 has been reachable from the public internet since 07:42 UTC (~6h15m at page time).

Intended rule: TCP/5432 restricted to 10.40.0.0/16 (data-plane VPC CIDR). Suggested fix: re-apply the intended rule via the IaC pipeline; confirm the 0.0.0.0/0 rule is gone.

NOTE: cfg-audit detects rule changes only. It does not inspect database connection or query activity, so the scope of any access during the exposure window is NOT characterized by this ticket.

worknotes.text: Auto-opened from cfg-audit finding CFG-7741 (sg-acctbilling-data 0.0.0.0/0 on 5432). Paged primary on-call via PD-2026-06-26-0042.

INC0049201.title: acct-billing replica lag spike
INC0049201.body: Read-replica lag on prod-db-7 crossed 90s during the nightly billing batch.

worknotes.text: Resolution: promoted standby replica, throttled the batch job to 4 workers. Lag back under 5s. MTTR 12.0 min. Closing.

INC0049188.title: acct-billing cache-tier OOM
INC0049188.body: Redis cache tier hit memory limit, evictions caused latency.

worknotes.text: Resolution: bumped maxmemory, redeployed. MTTR 9.2 min. Closing.

INC0049173.title: acct-billing LB health-check flap
INC0049173.body: Intermittent health-check failures on the acct-billing front-end LB.

worknotes.text: Resolution: corrected the probe path after a route change. MTTR 11.6 min. Closing.
